policy: de-is-de; ar-is-ar; no cross-language pronunciation-dictionary application
canonicalTextIntegrity: Never change canonical displayed words, question IDs, answer correctness, Quran/Hadith sourcing or Arabic originals to coerce TTS.

german.homographPolicy: The German particle 'nur', including sentence-initial 'Nur', remains German [nuːɐ̯]. German sentences must never run with an Arabic-global PLS.
german.arabicLoanTerms: Transliterated Islamic terms inside German syntax remain unchanged in the displayed text. Flag pronunciation for listening; if ambiguous isolate as approved Arabic speech segment, not as a German dictionary replacement.

arabic.textForm: Arabic script and verified Fuṣḥā with correct vocalization
arabic.quranTilawah: Never synthesize Qur'an recitation; use authorized real reciters.

mixed.handling: Human-edited list of separate nonempty {language:de|ar,text} segments. Each segment is generated with its own isolated language request and stitched only with verified joins and listening QA.
